messages:
sophia: Quick postmortem follow-up from the throughput regression last night. Pattern: periodic drop in throughput ~01:15-01:45 UTC correlating with cache warmup + an autoscaler edge case. We need to track remediation, owners, and SLO updates. Suggested changes: keep latency SLOs as-is for now, but raise throughput steady-state SLO from 90rps -> 105rps after autoscaler fixes and add a short-term guardrail SLO: 5m sustained drop > 20% triggers a page. Also move error-budget alert to 10m window for faster visibility. Please claim items by EOD: (1) SLO update + customer comms, (2) dashboard + short-window alerts, (3) autoscaler fix + loadtest, (4) runbook updates + mitigation commands.

raj: I'll take (3). Plan: fix scale-up cooldown and adjust target utilization from 0.6 -> 0.55. Will add imbalance detector metric so we can rebalance across zones. ETA: RFC + branch by Tue. I'll also run a 30m soak loadtest after changes.

sophia: Thanks. Please include a migration note for Dedicated customers about the SLO semantics change.

taylor: I'll pick (2). I'll add a 5m rolling throughput panel, a delta panel showing % drop vs baseline, and an alert: `increase(throughput_drop_total[5m]) / sum(throughput_baseline) > 0.20` -> page eng-oncall. Also add a small widget that shows recent autoscale events and their decision reasons.

taylor: Dashboard query examples:
- 5m throughput: `sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))`
- delta vs baseline: `sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) / avg_over_time(sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))[7d])`

owen: I'll take (4). Runbook additions: quick triage checklist, exact curl commands to force fallback, and steps to trigger manual scale in emergency. I'll add an explicit section for diagnosing cache warmup: check cache hit ratio, tail latencies, and recent eviction spikes.

owen: Runbook snippet:
```
# check cache evictions
curl -s http://metrics/query?query=sum(increase(cache_evictions_total[5m]))
# force fallback routing
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://deploy.internal/api/v1/routes/fallback -d '{"reason":"throughput-drop"}'
```

sophia: Good. I'll take (1) and draft the SLO PR and a short customer note. Plan to stage the SLO change in canary region first and monitor fallback triggers for 48h before rolling. Draft PR ETA: Fri.

slo-bot: IncidentBot: postmortem created at 2195012400 -> https://infra/reports/2195012345

taylor: I'll stage dashboards in dash-staging and post links when ready. ETA: Wed midday.

raj: RFC for autoscaler changes opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/rfcs/834. Will include rollback plan and test checklist.

sophia: Assigning action tracker (due dates):
- sophia: SLO PR + customer note  due 2026-04-02
- taylor: dashboards + 5m alerts  due 2026-03-30
- raj: autoscaler fixes + soak test  due 2026-03-31
- owen: runbook + mitigation commands  due 2026-03-29
We'll do a combined smoke test after changes and review at next SLO sync. Please ping if you need infra quota or assistance.

raj: Noted. I may need help coordinating the soak test window with platform infra.

taylor: Will post staging link when ready and request a quick walkthrough.

owen: Adding runbook PR shortly.

sophia: Thanks all. Let's try to get at least staging dashboards and the RFC landed this week so we can iterate quickly.
